subject: Partner pipeline handoff: NimbleData — overlap and proposed guardrails
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice@aperture.io>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: Partner overlap: NimbleData account - request for alignment

Hi Jonas (and Marissa),

Quick note — NimbleData reached back to say they've been in conversations with both Aperture and Redwood partners. Their procurement lead (Rajesh) flagged that they received parallel outreach and are unsure who owns the technical integration versus commercial motion. This is causing some confusion on timelines for the POC.

Can we align on a single point of contact and a simple handoff process so NimbleData doesn't get duplicate ask emails? We're happy to coordinate a joint intro call if helpful.

A few context bullets:
- NimbleData evaluating Redwood for embeddings + streaming inference (pilot for 5 engineering teams)
- Aperture positioned as systems integrator (we've done one pilot with them)
- Sales motion looks like: initial pilot -> SOW for integration -> potential annual license

Would appreciate a short mapping and next steps. Thanks — Alice

--
Alice Park
Head of Partnerships, Aperture Systems
alice@aperture.io

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 14:10:12 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Partner overlap: NimbleData account - request for alignment

Folks — forwarding Alice's note. NimbleData looks like a high-touch potential customer and we have both Alliance (Aperture) and direct Redwood reps engaged.

Can we propose a short escalation-free path to resolve ownership here? My suggested guardrails:
- Assign single commercial owner for contract/renewal (one internal SDR/AE)
- Allow partner (Aperture) to handle the integration engineering lane under a co-sell statement of work
- Create a 30-min cross-functional kickoff with NimbleData + Aperture + Redwood CS/SE to set scope and timeline

Please reply with who will own the commercial motion and any objections by EOD. If agreed, I'll coordinate the intro to Rajesh and Alice.

Jonas
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
